svg.title: SGLang server initialization order
svg.desc: The main process resolves ServerArgs, then launches scheduler and detokenizer processes and creates the TokenizerManager. It waits for READY from each scheduler over a pipe. The scheduler loads the model, sizes the KV pool, builds the pools and the tree cache, captures CUDA graphs, and sends READY. Only then does Uvicorn listen. A warmup request then marks the server Up.
